content: {"episode_id":"ep-05032","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"I appeal the CO-197 denial for mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229), for which authorization is missing. The clinical indication note documents recurrent episodes of syncope and transient neurological deficits suggestive of transient cerebral ischemic attacks, with diagnosis codes R55 and G45.9 listed for this case. Mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to evaluate for underlying arrhythmias or hemodynamic instability that may be contributing to the syncopal events and cerebral hypoperfusion."}
